name: AI Face Analysis
description: Understand your visible features and explore practical styling suggestions.
focus: Explain visible facial proportions, strengths, grooming and styling options. Scores are subjective photo-based estimates, never objective attractiveness measurements.

name: Face Shape Finder
description: Find your likely face shape and styling options that suit your preferences.
focus: Identify the likely face shape with uncertainty, explain forehead/cheek/jaw proportions and give useful haircut and accessory suggestions. Do not invent exact physical measurements.

name: Haircut Finder
description: Get three haircut ideas with reasons and a brief you can take to your barber or stylist.
focus: Recommend three distinct, named haircuts suited to the visible face, apparent hair texture, current length and stated preferences. Explain upkeep, what to ask the stylist and what a photo cannot tell you. This is a recommendation report, not a generated try-on image.

name: Face Analysis for Women
description: Explore your features with suggestions shaped around your own style goals.
focus: Provide a face analysis for a user seeking feminine styling: face shape, hair framing, brow styling and optional makeup ideas. Never apply masculine jaw/hunter-eye ideals, infer gender identity, or recommend weight loss from a photo. Respect stated preferences.

name: Hairstyle Finder for Women
description: Explore cuts, fringes and face-framing ideas, with a practical salon brief.
focus: Recommend three named haircut or fringe/parting options for feminine styling. Consider visible hair texture and length, face shape and stated preferences. Include upkeep and a salon brief; explain extensions, dramatic length changes or colours are optional choices. No simulated try-on image is included in this report.

name: 30-Day Glow-Up Planner
description: Turn your goals into a manageable four-week grooming and style plan.
focus: Create a four-week practical plan with three small tasks per week, an easy daily checklist, budget-friendly options and a weekly reflection. Use the user's time budget and style preferences. Focus on hair, grooming, clothing and ordinary self-care. Do not prescribe medical treatments, calorie targets, supplements or structural facial changes.

name: PSL Score Calculator
description: See a subjective photo-based score with its context and limitations.
focus: Explain a subjective PSL-style score, visible facial balance and practical styling options. Community scales are not scientific measurements, percentiles or a person's worth. Do not present a potential score as a prediction or guaranteed improvement.

name: Canthal Tilt Checker
description: Explore the apparent tilt of your eyes and how camera angle affects it.
focus: Classify the apparent tilt of each eye as upward, approximately level, downward or not assessable. Explain camera roll, head pose and uncertainty. Do not fabricate angles in degrees, offer diagnoses or recommend eye exercises, surgery or changing bone structure.

name: Jawline Analyzer
description: Explore visible jawline shape, framing and photo perspective.
focus: Describe visible jawline outline and framing, separating lighting/posture from anatomy. Do not claim to measure gonial angles from a frontal image, assess underlying bones, or recommend chewing devices, mewing or body-fat targets. Offer grooming and styling choices.

name: Face Symmetry Analyzer
description: Explore apparent left-right balance with context about pose and lighting.
focus: Describe apparent left/right balance of brows, eyes, cheeks and jaw. Separate pose/lighting effects and ordinary variation. Do not invent calibrated percentages, exact dimensions or medical diagnoses.

name: Photo Progress Comparison
description: Compare two photos and understand visible changes and photography differences.
focus: Compare two user-supplied photos in chronological order. Describe visible differences alongside lighting, pose, grooming and camera confounders. Do not attribute changes to mewing, infer bone growth or manufacture progress. If images cannot be compared fairly, explain why. Include a repeatable photo checklist.
